exposure: number of babies in multiple gestations
cohort: All fetal mortalities occurring between 22 weeks of gestation and birth at Babol hospitals in 2012-2013
finding: The stillbirth rate was 11.7 per 1000 cases, and stillbirth was significantly correlated with infant gender, the number of babies in multiple gestations, congenital abnormalities, underlying maternal diseases, and maternal conditions during pregnancy.
